description: Which of the City's 205 neighborhood outlines a point on the device falls in (docs/13; apps/web/src/hoodfind.ts hoodAt). The outlines ride in the signed bundle as indicators/neighborhoods.json; a point never leaves the device, and these cases are run against the bundle by each client. Expect null is a real answer: the City's outlines cover Detroit only, so Hamtramck, Highland Park, Dearborn, Windsor and the lake are in none of them and the screen says so rather than naming the nearest.

cases.name: the DIA, which the City files under Cultural Center, not Midtown
Dearborn, by the city hall: no neighborhood page
Hamtramck, Jos Campau: no neighborhood page
Highland Park, Woodward: no neighborhood page

note: zip_cases take the ZIP's centre point from places/zips.json, which is all the bundle carries: one point per ZIP. A ZIP covers more than one neighborhood, and the screen says so. When the bundle one day carries ZIP outlines, these lists grow and the cases stay where they are.
